verdict.rationale: Radar's rule engine, auto-pause payouts, and value-list based allow/block rules run autonomously in the background once configured (stripe-radar-docs-1, docs-2, docs-3, docs-14, docs-17), fitting the 'set up automations that run without manual intervention' story. However, this is a fraud-rules automation, not an AI-agent-oriented automation framework, and community evidence notes some automation behaviors (e.g., allow rules) are gated behind manual support enablement rather than fully self-serve (stripe-radar-comm-7). Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-agent-triggered or scheduled/programmatic automation setup beyond static rule definitions, no independent confirmation of unattended long-running automation reliability.
